# Hierarchies & dimensions

8 charts. Shared props, the data shapes and the recommender are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md).

**Contents:** [WaffleChart](#wafflechart) · [MarimekkoChart](#marimekkochart) · [SquarifiedTreemap](#squarifiedtreemap) · [SunburstChart](#sunburstchart) · [TreeChart](#treechart) · [ParallelCoordinatesChart](#parallelcoordinateschart) · [PolarLineChart](#polarlinechart) · [PolarScatterChart](#polarscatterchart)

## WaffleChart

`waffle-chart` · A unit grid filled in reading order by category.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `WaffleChart` | `SpWaffleChart` | `sp-waffle-chart` | `waffle_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/waffle-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/waffle-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/waffle-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `parts`; intents `part-to-whole`, `progress`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | `nameKey` | string | yes |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through nameKey="use", valueKey="kwh"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "use": "Heating", "kwh": 412 }, { "use": "Water heating", "kwh": 263 }, { "use": "Appliances", "kwh": 158 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nameKey` | `Accessor<string \| number>` | `'name'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `cells` | `number` | `100` | Cells in the grid; 100 by default. |
| `columns` | `number` | `10` | Cells per row; 10 by default. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { WaffleChart } from '@silverpoint/react/waffle-chart';

export function WaffleChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <WaffleChart
      data={rows}
      nameKey="use"
      valueKey="kwh"
      title="Waffle chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SpWaffleChart } from '@silverpoint/vue/waffle-chart';

defineProps<{ rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SpWaffleChart
    :data="rows"
    nameKey="use"
    valueKey="kwh"
    title="Waffle chart"
  />
</template>
```

```ts angular

import { SpWaffleChart } from '@silverpoint/angular/waffle-chart';

    <sp-waffle-chart
      [data]="rows()"
      [nameKey]="'use'"
      [valueKey]="'kwh'"
      [title]="'Waffle chart'"
    />
  `,
})
export class WaffleChartView {
  readonly rows = input.required<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]>();
}
```

## SquarifiedTreemap

`squarified-treemap` · Nested rectangles, area by value, drillable through `rootId` and `onRootChange`.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `SquarifiedTreemap` | `SpSquarifiedTreemap` | `sp-squarified-treemap` | `squarified_treemap` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/squarified-treemap` | `@silverpoint/vue/squarified-treemap` | `@silverpoint/angular/squarified-treemap` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `hierarchy`; intents `hierarchy`, `part-to-whole`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | `idKey` | string | yes |
| parent | `parentKey` | string | yes |
| label | `labelKey` | string | no |
| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through idKey="id", parentKey="parent", labelKey="name", valueKey="amount"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "id": "budget", "parent": null, "name": "City budget" }, { "id": "works", "parent": "budget", "name": "Public works" }, { "id": "works-01", "parent": "works", "name": "Roads" } ]
```

Drillable: bind `rootId` and listen to `onRootChange` (`@root-change`, `(rootChange)`); the chart holds no root of its own.

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idKey` | `Accessor<string>` | `'id'` | Ignored without `data`. |
| `parentKey` | `Accessor<string \| null \| undefined>` | `'parent'` | `null` for the root. Ignored without `data`. |
| `labelKey` | `Accessor<string \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | Read on leaves; an internal node is the sum of its children. Ignored without `data`. |
| `depth` | `number` |  | Levels drawn below the root; all by default. |
| `rootId` | `string \| null` |  | The node drawn as root, controlled (REQ-439); the data root by default. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { SquarifiedTreemap } from '@silverpoint/react/squarified-treemap';

export function SquarifiedTreemapView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <SquarifiedTreemap
      data={rows}
      idKey="id"
      parentKey="parent"
      labelKey="name"
      valueKey="amount"
      title="Squarified treemap"
    />
  );
}
```

## ParallelCoordinatesChart

`parallel-coordinates-chart` · One polyline per row across parallel axes.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | `ParallelCoordinatesChart` | `SpParallelCoordinatesChart` | `sp-parallel-coordinates-chart` | `parallel_coordinates_chart` |
| Import | `@silverpoint/react/parallel-coordinates-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/parallel-coordinates-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/parallel-coordinates-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `matrix`; intents `correlation`, `compare`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| label | `labelKey` | string | no |
| dimensions | `dimensions` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through labelKey="model", dimensions=["mass","gears","price","range","rating"]), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "model": "Model 01", "mass": 13.9, "gears": 15, "price": 3434, "range": 125, "rating": 1.5 }, { "model": "Model 02", "mass": 8.6, "gears": 22, "price": 3897, "range": 29, "rating": 3.8 }, { "model": "Model 03", "mass": 19.5, "gears": 13, "price": 3202, "range": 62, "rating": 2.9 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `labelKey` | `Accessor<string \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `dimensions` | `readonly string[]` |  | **Required.** The dimension columns, in axis order. Ignored without `data`. |
| `domains` | `Readonly<Record<string, readonly [number, number]>>` |  | Axis domains by dimension; derived from the data when omitted (REQ-097). |

## PolarLineChart

`polar-line-chart` · A line over angle and radius.

|  | React | Vue | Angular | Reflex |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |

| value | `valueKey` | number | yes |

The demo's first rows (read through angleKey="month", valueKey="rain", period=12), drawn when `data` is omitted:


### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `angleKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'angle'` | In the units of `period`. Ignored without `data`. |
| `valueKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'value'` | The radius, `≥ 0`. Ignored without `data`. |
| `period` | `number` |  | One turn, in the units of the angle; when set, the line closes. Ignored without `data`. |

| Import | `@silverpoint/react/polar-scatter-chart` | `@silverpoint/vue/polar-scatter-chart` | `@silverpoint/angular/polar-scatter-chart` | `reflex_silverpoint_react` |

**Data:** shape `points`; intents `distribution`, `correlation`.

| Role | Accessor prop | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| angle | `angleKey` | number | yes |
| radius | `radiusKey` | number | yes |
| size | `sizeKey` | number | no |

The demo's first rows (read through angleKey="bearing", radiusKey="distance"), drawn when `data` is omitted:

```json
[ { "bearing": 28, "distance": 2.5 }, { "bearing": 149.6, "distance": 1.4 }, { "bearing": 229.3, "distance": 19.6 } ]
```

### Props

Its own props; the 23 common ones are in [choosing-charts.md](../choosing-charts.md#common-chart-props).

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `angleKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'angle'` | In the units of `period`. Ignored without `data`. |
| `radiusKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` | `'radius'` | The radius, `≥ 0`. Ignored without `data`. |
| `sizeKey` | `Accessor<number \| null \| undefined>` |  | Ignored without `data`. |
| `period` | `number` | `360` | One turn, in the units of the angle; 360 by default. Ignored without `data`. |

### Example

```tsx
import '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css';
import '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css';
import { PolarScatterChart } from '@silverpoint/react/polar-scatter-chart';

export function PolarScatterChartView({ rows }: { rows: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] }) {
  return (
    <PolarScatterChart
      data={rows}
      angleKey="bearing"
      radiusKey="distance"
      title="Polar scatter chart"
    />
  );
}
```

```ts angular
import { ChangeDetectionStrategy, Component, input } from '@angular/core';
import { SpPolarScatterChart } from '@silverpoint/angular/polar-scatter-chart';

/** Add '@silverpoint/fonts/fonts.css', '@silverpoint/grounds/styles.css' to the `styles` of angular.json. */
@Component({
  selector: 'app-polar-scatter-chart-view',
  imports: [SpPolarScatterChart],
  changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush,
  template: `
    <sp-polar-scatter-chart
      [data]="rows()"
      [angleKey]="'bearing'"
      [radiusKey]="'distance'"
      [title]="'Polar scatter chart'"
    />
  `,
})
export class PolarScatterChartView {
  readonly rows = input.required<readonly Record<string, unknown>[]>();
}
```
